arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS users_with_online_transactions FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE t.transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'
arguments.explanation: Counts how many different users made at least one online transaction on any of their cards.
assumptions: "How much users" is read as the number of distinct users.
An online transaction is one with transaction_type = 'Online Transaction'.
Transactions are linked to users through the card used (cards.user_id), and every transaction counts, whether or not it has a fraud label.
The count covers all the data, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
